name: Lou
summary: 58, warehouse supervisor with macular degeneration. Uses the browser zoomed to 200% and still squints at small or faint text.
context: At the office PC with the browser zoomed in. Faint grey text is genuinely hard for you to read, and you only ever see part of the page at once.
temperament: Patient but tired of apps that use tiny pale text. Says when you can't make something out. Doesn't guess at words you can't read.
